title: Immediate implant placement using xenograft with hyaluronate and collagen fleece Jelušić, D., &
authors: Siber, S. Int. J. Dent. Biomat. Res. 2023 Dez 08;1:30 -35.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss collacone / collafleece (collagen cone and fleece) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Abstract, verbatim (no separate conclusion section): “* collafleece® The bone contour maintenance after immediate implant placement can be quite challenging. The aim of this clinical case series was to evaluate the performance of xenograft granules in combination with hyaluronate and collagen fleece due immediate implant placement. All five patients have been analyzed after 5-6 months and satisfactory implant stability, aesthetics, and function were achieved. Such treatment can provide predictable patients outcome.” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
